sections.title: SRN AND CNTRL PLAINS/OZARKS/MID-MS VALLEY/OH VALLEY
sections.text: A FLAT UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE OVER THE GULF COAST STATES WILL BE IN PLACE TODAY WITH SOUTHWEST FLOW OVER THE SRN PLAINS. AT THE SFC...A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT SHOULD BE LOCATED FROM FAR SRN OK INTO CNTRL MO AND THE OH VALLEY. MODEL FORECASTS SHOW AN MCS THIS MORNING OVER THE OH VALLEY WITH AN UNDISTURBED AIRMASS EXTENDING SWWD ACROSS THE OZARKS INTO THE SRN PLAINS. SFC HEATING SHOULD RESULT IN MODERATE INSTABILITY BY MIDDAY ALONG AND SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY WITH SOME AREAS DEVELOPING STRONG INSTABILITY AS IN PREVIOUS DAYS. THE BEST CHANCE FOR STRONG INSTABILITY SHOULD OCCUR IN THE OZARKS WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS WILL LIKELY BE NEAR 70 F. NAM FORECAST SOUNDINGS AT MIDDAY IN SW MO SHOW 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES OF 8.5 TO 9.0 C/KM WITH MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 3000 TO 3500 J/KG RANGE. THIS ALONG WITH VEERED LOW-LEVEL WIND PROFILES SHOULD ENHANCE DOWNDRAFT EFFICIENCY BEING FAVORABLE FOR WIND DAMAGE. THE GREATEST CHANCE FOR WIND DAMAGE SHOULD BE WITH BOWING-LINE SEGMENTS EARLY THIS EVENING FROM NE OK EWD ACROSS SRN MO INTO WRN KY WHERE FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW 25 TO 30 KT JUST ABOVE THE BOUNDARY LAYER. MODERATE VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES WILL ALSO BE FAVORABLE FOR ISOLATED SUPERCELLS WITH THE GREATEST LARGE HAIL

sections.title: MID-ATLANTIC/CAROLINAS
sections.text: MODEL FORECASTS AGAIN DEVELOP MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS MUCH OF THE ERN SEABOARD TODAY WITH SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS INITIATING AS SFC TEMPS WARM. VERTICAL SHEAR ON FORECAST SOUNDINGS APPEARS TO BE ON THE LOW-END FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE. HOWEVER...MODERATE INSTABILITY AND STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES MAY BE ENOUGH FOR ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE. HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MORE INTENSE CELLS. THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE SHOULD BE ACROSS THE CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS WHERE FORECAST SOUNDINGS IN THE LATE AFTERNOON SHOW VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES IN THE 850-600 MB LAYER.

sections.title: ERN COLORADO
sections.text: THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD INITIATE IN THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF ECNTRL CO AROUND MIDDAY WITH CONVECTION MOVING EWD ACROSS THE CO HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON. FORECAST SOUNDINGS AT 21Z SUGGEST STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL BE IN PLACE WITH MODERATE VERTICAL SHEAR. THIS SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS. SEVERE STORM COVERAGE SHOULD DEPEND ON HOW MUCH INSTABILITY CAN MATERIALIZE BY THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS THE REGION. ..BROYLES.. 06/10/2009

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: BROAD BELT OF 40-50KT W/WSWLY FLOW EXTENDS FROM COAST-TO-COAST TODAY BETWEEN LARGE SCALE TROUGHING OVER CANADA AND NRN BORDER STATES...AND SUB-TROPICAL RIDGE OVER MEXICO/SRN TX AND THE ADJACENT GULF OF MEXICO. NRN PERIPHERY OF THE SUB-TROPICAL RIDGE AXIS WILL BECOME SUPPRESSED ACROSS THE SRN GREAT PLAINS TODAY AS A SHORT WAVE TROUGH EJECTS NEWD FROM AZ/NM. AT THE SFC...A COMPLEX QUASI-STATIONARY FRONTAL ZONE...FRACTURED IN A NUMBER OF AREAS BY DIURNAL/EPISODIC CONVECTION...EXTENDS FROM ERN CO FRONT RANGE SEWD TO KS/OK...AND THEN EWD TO THE LOWER OH VALLEY. THE FRONT BECOMES A BIT MORE DIFFUSE FROM THE OH VALLEY ACROSS THE APPALACHIANS TO THE EAST COAST. TSTM DEVELOPMENT AND EVOLUTION ALONG/NEAR THE ENTIRE EXTENT OF THIS FRONTAL ZONE WILL BE MODULATED BY SEVERAL COMPLEX FACTORS TODAY INCLUDING: 1)FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH THE MORE SUBSTANTIAL SHORT WAVE TROUGH MOVING OUT OF THE SOUTHWEST...AS WELL AS A WEAKER LEADING LOW-AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE MOVING FROM MO EWD TO THE OH VALLEY...2) PLACEMENT/LOCATION OF RESIDUAL STORM OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AND THEIR LOCATION WITH RESPECT TO POTENTIAL FRONTAL WAVES/ENHANCED DEEP-LAYER ASCENT...AND 3) LOW LEVEL MOISTURE AXES/DISCONTINUITIES INCLUDING RESIDU

sections.title: SRN PLAINS
sections.text: IT IS DIFFICULT TO BE TOO SPECIFIC WITH REGARD TO STORM DEVELOPMENT/CHARACTER ACROSS THIS LARGE REGION TODAY GIVEN COMPLEXITIES ALREADY MENTIONED. LARGE SCALE LIFT WITH THE MID/UPPER TROUGH EJECTING FROM AZ/NM WAS ALREADY CONTRIBUTING TO ISOLATED STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER A BROAD REGION. RECENT DEVELOPMENT WAS ALSO INCREASING ALONG CONFLUENCE ZONE FROM TRANS-PECOS AREA NEWD ALONG THE CAPROCK WHERE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE SURGE WAS OVERCOMING DRIER AIR IN THE WAKE OF DRYLINE SURGE THAT OCCURRED ON TUESDAY. STRENGTHENING BACKGROUND ASCENT ON THE LARGE SCALE WILL SUPPORT AN INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE THROUGH THE DAY. WITH SURFACE LOW PRESSURE FORECAST TO PERSIST ACROSS TX/OK...AND THE FRONTAL ZONE SITUATED ACROSS THE PNHDLS AND NRN OK...EXPECT MORE VIGOROUS AND ORGANIZED STORMS TO BECOME MOST PREVALENT NEAR THESE FEATURES AND BOUNDARIES. STORM INTENSITY IN TX MAY BE LIMITED BY SUBSTANTIAL CONVECTIVE INHIBITION AND WIDESPREAD CLOUD COVER. A CORRIDOR OF STRONGER SURFACE HEATING/DESTABILIZATION MAY OCCUR FROM TX PNHDL ACROSS WRN OK...AND NEAR THE FRONT IN OK/SRN KS WHERE LATEST SATELLITE IMAGERY SUGGESTS MORE LIMITED CLOUD COVER EXISTS THIS MORNING. STORMS SHOULD BECOME INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED AS

sections.title: MIDWEST/LOWER OH VALLEY
sections.text: A ZONE OF ENHANCED STORM POTENTIAL MAY BECOME ESTABLISHED FROM MO/IL EWD ACROSS THE LOWER OH VALLEY THROUGH THE DAY. LIFT WITH THE LOW-AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCE NOW DRIVING STORMS ACROSS SERN MO WILL CONTINUE TO PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE RESIDUAL FRONTAL BOUNDARY DRAPED ACROSS THE REGION. DESPITE WIDESPREAD CLOUDS ACROSS THE REGION ATTM...POCKETS OF GREATER SURFACE-BASED DESTABILIZATION APPEAR POSSIBLE GIVEN RICH LOW LEVEL MOISTURE AND PERSISTENT PLUME OF STEEP LAPSE RATES. EFFECTIVE FLOW AS FORECAST WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS AND LINE SEGMENTS WITH HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL.

sections.title: EAST
sections.text: ANOTHER DAY OF DIURNAL/TERRAIN-INDUCED DEEP CONVECTION IS FORECAST FROM PA/WV SWD ACROSS THE CAROLINAS. STORMS WILL LIKELY INITIATE ACROSS THE HIGHER TERRAIN EARLY AIDED BY DIFFERENTIAL HEATING...BROADLY DIFFLUENT MID/UPPER LEVEL FLOW...AND WEAK HEIGHT FALLS. THIS ACTIVITY WILL THEN MOVE EAST INTO LOWER ELEVATIONS WHERE STRONG HEATING AND DESTABILIZATION WILL CONTRIBUTE DOWNBURST AND SEVERE HAIL POTENTIAL. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR ON THE ORDER OF 20-30KT INDICATES PRIMARY CONVECTIVE MODE SHOULD BE MULTICELLULAR. HOWEVER...SOME LOCAL/GREATER ORGANIZATION IS POSSIBLE AS STORM MERGERS GENERATE EXPANDING/STRONG COLD POOLS.

sections.title: HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: MOIST UPSLOPE FLOW WILL AGAIN AID STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS CO/SERN WY AND ADJACENT AREAS OF NE/KS TODAY WITHIN SUFFICIENTLY SHEARED FLOW FOR SUPERCELLS. WHILE LIFT WITH THE APPROACHING SHORT WAVE TROUGH MAY LEAD TO MORE NUMEROUS STORMS COMPARED TO PRIOR DAYS...INCREASING CLOUD COVER WITH THIS SYSTEM MAY ALSO ACT TO INHIBIT GREATER DESTABILIZATION. NONETHELESS...PRESENCE OF LARGE SCALE ASCENT...LOCALLY STRONGER LOW LEVEL SHEAR ALONG RESIDUAL FRONTAL ZONE...AND STEEP LAPSE RATES...SHOULD LEAD TO AT LEAST A FEW SEVERE STORMS WITH HAIL AND HIGH WIND POTENTIAL. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THIS CONVECTION COULD CONGEAL INTO A SMALL MCS AND MOVE ACROSS WRN KS/NE LATER TONIGHT. ..CARBIN/HURLBUT.. 06/10/2009

sections.title: TX/OK/KS/MO THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: A LARGE CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS IS DEVELOPING NEWD FROM W TX TOWARD WRN OK IN A REGION OF ASCENT IMMEDIATELY DOWNSTREAM FROM A LEAD SHORTWAVE TROUGH EJECTING NEWD OVER W TX...ALONG A MOISTURE GRADIENT THAT IS RETREATING SLOWLY NWD. THIS EJECTING WAVE IS PRECEDED BY A LARGE PLUME OF MID LEVEL MOISTURE/CLOUDS WHICH WILL SLOW SURFACE HEATING...THOUGH CLOUD BREAKS IN EXISTENCE FROM NE OK INTO SW MO AND THINNING CLOUDS OVER PARTS OF NW TX WILL ALLOW LOCALLY STRONGER DESTABILIZATION. MODIFIED REGIONAL 12Z SOUNDINGS SUPPORT AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 2000-3500 J/KG RANGE...WHILE ASCENT/MOISTENING DOWNSTREAM FROM THE EJECTING MID LEVEL TROUGH WILL HELP REDUCE CONVECTIVE INHIBITION AND AID IN THE MAINTENANCE OF THE ONGOING CONVECTION SPREADING NEWD FROM W TX. MID-UPPER SWLY FLOW WILL INCREASE FROM SW TO NE WITH THE APPROACH OF THE MID LEVEL WAVE TODAY /PER THE OBSERVED 50-60 KT FLOW FROM 2-5 KM AGL AT MAF/LUB AND TCC/. THIS INCREASING FLOW WILL CONTRIBUTE TO SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED STORM CLUSTERS...AND POTENTIALLY SUPERCELLS. CYCLOGENESIS DOWNSTREAM FROM THE MID LEVEL WAVE IS RATHER WEAK AND LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS NOT PARTICULARLY WELL-ORGANIZED...THUS DAMAGING WINDS AND LAR

sections.title: OH/TN VALLEYS EWD TO VA/WRN NC THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: A COUPLE OF EMBEDDED SHORTWAVE TROUGHS FROM IL/INDIANA SWD TO WRN TN WILL CONTINUE TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH SEVERAL THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS FROM NRN AL TO ERN KY AND WV. SURFACE HEATING AND INSTABILITY ARE SOMEWHAT GREATER IN ADVANCE OF THE AL CLUSTER...COMPARED TO LESSER BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE AND MORE WIDESPREAD CLOUDS IN ADVANCE OF THE CONVECTION ACROSS KY/WV. GIVEN ADDITIONAL DESTABILIZATION THROUGH EARLY-MID AFTERNOON...THE NRN AL STORM CLUSTER COULD EVENTUALLY POSE A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WHILE IT PROGRESSES SEWD. THE DAMAGING WIND/HAIL THREAT FARTHER N ACROSS KY/WV IS MORE MARGINAL THAN YESTERDAY AS A RESULT OF WEAKER LAPSE RATES/INSTABILITY. A LITTLE GREATER THREAT FOR SEVERE STORMS MAY EXIST JUST E OF THE APPALACHIANS AS THE CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS AND ASSOCIATED MID LEVEL WAVE REACH THIS AREA LATER THIS AFTERNOON. SPECIFICALLY...STRONGER SURFACE HEATING AND RICHER BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE ACROSS WRN VA WILL RESULT IN A LITTLE GREATER INSTABILITY COMPARED TO AREAS FARTHER W...AND BEFORE HIGH CLOUDS OVERSPREAD THE AREA THIS AFTERNOON.

sections.title: HIGH PLAINS AREA THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: WIDESPREAD CLOUDS AND A MID LEVEL MOISTURE PLUME WILL CONTINUE TO OVERSPREAD THE TX/OK PANHANDLES...WRN KS...AND ERN CO IN ADVANCE OF THE MID LEVEL TROUGH EJECTING NEWD OVER NM. SURFACE HEATING WILL BE LIMITED BY THE CLOUDS...AND MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE SUBSTANTIALLY WEAKER WITHIN THE MOIST PLUME...THUS INSTABILITY WILL BE LIMITED THIS AFTERNOON. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS...BUT WILL OUTLOOK ONLY LOW SEVERE PROBABILITIES GIVEN THE AFOREMENTIONED INSTABILITY CONCERNS. ..THOMPSON/GARNER.. 06/10/2009

sections.title: TX/OK/KS/MO/NRN AR
sections.text: PRIMARY SHORT-TERM SEVERE POTENTIAL HAS SHIFTED SWD INTO TX AND SRN OK...WITH KS AND MUCH OF OK NOW COVERED BY WIDESPREAD CLOUDINESS ASSOCIATED WITH A WEAKENING CONVECTIVE CLUSTER. MEANWHILE...GREATER HEATING/DESTABILIZATION HAS OCCURRED ACROSS TX...WITH STORMS CONTINUING TO DEVELOP FROM THE TRANSPECOS/SOUTH PLAINS REGION ENEWD INTO SWRN OK ALONG AN AXIS OF SURFACE CONVERGENCE. THIS CONVECTION IS ASSOCIATED WITH A MID-LEVEL TROUGH MOVING OUT OF THE SRN ROCKIES. ENHANCED DEEP-LAYER WIND FIELD ASSOCIATED WITH THIS TROUGH SPREADING ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED/SUPERCELL STORMS. DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL SHOULD REMAIN THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREATS...AS LOW-LEVEL SHEAR REMAINS SOMEWHAT WEAK THUS LIMITING TORNADO POTENTIAL. FARTHER NE INTO MO/NRN AR...CONVECTIVE DEBRIS CONTINUES TO OVERSPREAD THE REGION FROM THE WEST...BUT STRONG DESTABILIZATION HAS ALREADY OCCURRED NEAR AND S OF THE SURFACE FRONT WHICH EXTENDS ROUGHLY W-E ACROSS THE CENTRAL THIRD OF MO. AS THE UPPER TROUGH APPROACHES FROM THE WEST...INCREASING UPPER DIVERGENCE AND THE INTENSIFICATION OF THE LOW-LEVEL JET SHOULD RESULT IN WIDESPREAD STORM DEVELOPMENT BEGINNING BY LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. sections.title: OH/TN VALLEYS EWD INTO THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS
sections.text: A SHORT-WAVE TROUGH NOW CROSSING THE MID OH/TN VALLEY REGION WITHIN ENHANCED WSWLY FLOW ALOFT CONTINUES TO SUPPORT SCATTERED SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS THIS REGION. STORMS ARE ALSO ONGOING ACROSS S CENTRAL PA WHERE SOMEWHAT GREATER DESTABILIZATION HAS OCCURRED...WITH DEVELOPMENT NOW EXPANDING SWD ALONG THE APPALACHIANS INTO WRN AND CENTRAL VA. SHEAR REMAINS RELATIVELY MODEST ACROSS THE AREA...BUT IS SUFFICIENT FOR LOCALLY-ORGANIZED/MULTICELL STORMS -- AND ASSOCIATED THREAT FOR LOCALLY-DAMAGING WINDS AND/OR HAIL THROUGH MID-EVENING.

sections.title: HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: LIMITED INSTABILITY IS INDICATED ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS FROM WY SWD TO NM THIS AFTERNOON...THOUGH SCATTERED SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE MID-LEVEL TROUGH NOW CROSSING CO/NM. A LIMITED THREAT FOR HAIL AND LOCALLY-DAMAGING WINDS WILL CONTINUE INTO THE EVENING...BEFORE STORMS WEAKEN. ONE EXCEPTION TO THIS DIURNAL WEAKENING MAY OCCUR ACROSS SERN WY/NERN CO AND INTO ADJACENT NEB/KS...WHERE ELY LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE COMPONENT MAY ALLOW STORMS TO PERSIST LONGER INTO THE EVENING. ALSO...WITH SOMEWHAT ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL VEERING/SHEAR DUE TO THE LOW-LEVEL BACKED FLOW...AN ISOLATED TORNADO IS ALSO POSSIBLE.

sections.title: AL/GA
sections.text: LOOSELY-ORGANIZED CLUSTERS OF STORMS CONTINUE MOVING SEWD ACROSS NRN AL/NWRN GA...WITHIN MEAN NWLY FLOW FIELD. AMPLE DOWNSTREAM INSTABILITY SUGGESTS THAT STORMS MAY CONTINUE FOR SEVERAL HOURS -- AND WHILE THE OVERALL SEVERE POTENTIAL HAS REMAINED LOW THUS FAR...WILL NUDGE THE SLIGHT RISK AREA FARTHER SE TO ACCOUNT FOR POSSIBLE ADDITIONAL ORGANIZATION THIS AFTERNOON. ..GOSS.. 06/10/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1129 AM CDT WED JUN 10 2009/
